name: Rupture
author: Erin Carter
description: A corrupted signal — blocky colour content torn into horizontal bands that jump and shuffle on discrete glitch frames, channels split into red/blue ghosts, bright scan tears and black dropouts flickering through. Digital, broken, kinetic.

params.label: Corruption
params.effect: Overall intensity of the tearing, shuffling and dropouts; 0 settles the signal, 1 is heavy datamosh.

params.label: Glitch rate
params.effect: How many new glitch frames hit per second; low is occasional jolts, high a constant scramble.

params.label: Channel split
params.effect: How far the red and blue channels separate into chromatic ghosts.

params.label: Block size
params.effect: Coarseness of the underlying block field; low is big slabs, high a fine mosaic.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer tears the band at its row; 0 ignores the mouse.
